notes.title: Angel Emica ( v1.5 update )
notes.notes:
Content added
New Clothes - Fighter. It requires the player to hold the direction key and manage 'Chi' consumption to use the skill.

Chip exchanger added. Allowing players to exchange chips for a higher tier and buy chips with coins. It will only appear after beating the game.

Silver-tier statue. Upgrading the statue to +8 to unlock. Similar to bronze-tier, it will unlock more abilities of the statue. However, it requires green chips to upgrade, which can be obtained from the 'Chip exchanger'.

2 new fusions have been added. 

Inquisitor ( hand gun + holy aura)

Angelic sword art ( Combat halo + dusk sword)

\[Note: These 2 fusions are available at the start, which hopefully helps new players clear the early stages of the game.]
Change and balance
Stage 1 background, coin icon, and pixel art for 'Clothes - angel' have been redrawn.

Stage 1 enemy HP has been adjusted. 

Stage difficulty setting has been removed. \[Note: setting up for adding 'Hard mode' in the future]

In stages, when the tower is fully charged, it needs to be manually activated to spawn the boss.

statue follower 'rook' and 'Shroom kid' now work differently than before.


Bug fix
Game crashes when fusing certain fusions. (fixed)

Some player attack boxes didn't work properly. (fixed)

notes.title: version 1.4a patch
notes.notes:
Bug fix
Endless mode
 - Game crashes when the 'Boss-sword type' clone hits the player. (Fixed)
 - 3 bosses can't be picked in the random boss pool. (Fixed)
 - Special enemies don't give exp to the player. (Fixed)
 - The gate crystal modifier fails to work properly. (Fixed)

Improvement
- Normal and special enemy game sprite redrawn.
- Purple shroom enemies only play 1 shooting sound effect.

Change and Balance
- The gate crystal modifier will give random chips when the player passes 1 wave in endless mode.
- 'Dusk sword' base size increase.
- 'Sword of light' fusion materials requirement change from 3 to 2. Now just need 'Dusk sword' and 'Guardian sword'.
- Adjusting some bosses in endless mode.
